title: Distinguishing Liabilities From Equity
summary: Establishes the criteria for classifying financial instruments as liabilities or equity, including mandatorily redeemable instruments, obligations to repurchase shares, and mezzanine equity.
description: ASC 480 establishes the classification criteria for distinguishing liabilities from equity for financial instruments, including mandatorily redeemable instruments, obligations to repurchase equity, and puttable shares.
